limitations: Actual SwiftUI views are typechecked; units exercise shared state, Binding and callbacks used by those views, not SwiftUI-generated accessibility tree, executed Button closure installation, environment propagation, spoken output, focus delivery or rendered layout. Media choices are application state only.

claims.section: Public SwiftUI API composition; exact installed SDK declarations and narrow application contract
claims.statement: Public native coordinator configuration/action/dismantle paths, with separate AppKit/UIKit implementation. Not automatic hosting/update propagation.
claims.availability: Compile target26 against SDK27; exact runtime recorded separately. Platform-specific unavailable members must be excluded or explicitly unresolved, not guessed.
